summary: Added Graph.cbd(resource) to rdflib/graph.py as the last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph. It implements the three W3C CBD rules: rule 1 adds subject triples and recurses into undescribed blank-node objects; rule 2 adds all triples of any statement whose rdf:subject is the node (no rdf:Statement or predicate/object matching); rule 3 does not follow reifier object/predicate values. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (testCbd, testCbdTypedReifier, testCbdUntypedReifier, testCbdIncomingReification, testCbdReifiedBlankNodeNotExpanded, testCbdBlankNodeCycle, testCbdSourceUnchanged) using an inline Turtle fixture built to match the spec's counts, plus a unittest.main() guard. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the tests are unverified.
